[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 120
- Description: Self-serve currency definition — raw machine execution (GAS deploy @15, UAT U1–U5, retry-bug root-cause, cleanup)
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/tokenomics/pull/489
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1077
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1078
  
  Details:
  Raw machine execution (Sophia Truesight) — the tool/SSH/script time for the QR self-serve currency unit (thread 27015).
  
  WHAT CHANGED
  - Deployed the tokenomics GAS project (1N6o00…) to prod: clasp push --force (4 files), created version 15, repointed the pinned deployment AKfycbxn3siu… -> @15 (reused the existing deployment, no new URL); live probe returned {"status":"success"}.
  - Ran UAT U1–U4 on prod with a labeled TEST currency row: define_currency via Edgar (HTTP 200, signature_verification: success); Currencies row verified QR-ready (col C=TRUE, cols E–J populated, sorted A->Z); batch_qr_generator minted QRs (Agroverse QR codes rows 1824–1827 = MINTED; QR Code Generation row -> start/end 1827|1827, zip on lineage-assets); idempotency re-submit produced no duplicate row.
  - Root-caused the 4x-mint anomaly with hard evidence: dao_protocol webhook_trigger.py retries the slow GAS webhook 3x on 30s read-timeouts (journalctl: attempts 1/3, 2/3, 3/3 then success); Apps Script keeps executing after the client disconnects; the handler's dedupe (processedMessageIds.includes + findExistingQRCodeGenerationRow) is a non-atomic read-then-write with NO LockService -> N attempts = N minted rows.
  - U5 cleanup: removed all TEST artifacts — main-ledger "Agroverse QR codes" rows 1824–1827, workbook 1qbZZhf "QR Code Generation" rows 17–20, the Currencies TEST row, and 4 orphan PNGs on lineage-assets (via Contents API; verified API 404).
  - Worked out the Google Sheets protection/permission map to execute the cleanup: "Agroverse QR codes" range is owner-only (editors=None) except the agroverse-qr-code-manager SA; 1qbZZhf write access belongs to qr-code-manager/market-research/edgar-dapp-listener, not ledger-manager.
  
  EVIDENCE (pull requests)
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/tokenomics/pull/489 (PR4 — auto-define QR-ready currency)
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1077 (PR5 — self-serve currency docs)
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1078 (UAT PASS close-out + duplicate-mint defect)
  
  Raw machine time estimate: ~130 tool ops across deploy, UAT, diagnostics, SA/permission probing, and multi-workbook cleanup; rough wall-clock ~120 min. This is an explicit estimate of raw machine/tool execution time.
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight

- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
